rule_text: Cashback Wallet terms: credited balance is valid 6 months from date of credit; cannot be used toward Aayushmaan, Total Joy, or YumDum brand products; eligibility is calculated on a weekly cycle running Thursday to the following Wednesday.
notes: OCR-verified, pages 31-32, Cashback Wallet Terms & Conditions panel.

rule_text: Distributor Loyalty Program (4-month consistency offer): a distributor who buys a minimum of Rs 2,500 worth of product every month, across multiple invoices between the 2nd and 15th of the month, for 4 consecutive months, receives free products worth their 4-month average in the 5th month, capped at a maximum benefit of Rs 7,500. Requires Self ID activated with minimum 2,500 BV. Coupon valid 6 months, single-invoice redemption only, cannot be used on Aayushmaan/YumDum/Total Joy food products, and no BV is earned on purchases made using the coupon.
notes: OCR-verified, page 28. IMPORTANT: distributor_system_narrative_UNSTRUCTURED.md section 5.11 describes a DIFFERENT, conflicting version of this program (Rs 3,000/month, 5 consecutive months, 6th-month payout, cap Rs 3,000-6,000 tiered) sourced from web:68. That narrative version is NOT corroborated by this OCR-verified page and is recorded separately as UNVERIFIED (see BONUS-U row for 'Loyalty Program (narrative/web:68 version)'). Use the OCR-verified figures in this row as authoritative; do not blend the two versions.

rule_text: Super Retailer Loyalty Program (4-month consistency offer): a distributor who purchases a minimum of Rs 25,000 worth of product on their Self ID, across multiple invoices between the 2nd and 15th of the month, continuously for 4 months, receives free products worth Rs 25,000 after the 5th month's billing. Offer is repeatable each 4-month cycle.
notes: OCR-verified, page 29.

rule_text: Beyond standard commissions, Dayjoy offers 17 Lifetime Reward Clubs — a permanent, one-time reward (cash and/or gifts such as gadgets, vehicles, property, or travel) unlocked at each club milestone. Full per-club detail is in the rank_structure rows of this file.
notes: OCR-verified.

rule_text: Rewards are non-transferable; reward cash must be used solely for the purchase of the specified reward gift (e.g., the car/bike/property/travel package named for that club).
notes: OCR-verified, page 53, rule 9 of 10.

rule_text: Mentorship Income can be earned from a single business group — described in the plan as a 'unique advantage' (i.e., a balanced two-team binary structure is not required specifically for mentorship income to accrue, though it is required for other qualification purposes).
notes: OCR-verified statement of eligibility mechanics only — this row does NOT state or imply the mentorship rate itself, which remains CONFLICT (see CONF-002).

rule_text: Business Plan closing is done on a weekly basis, every Wednesday. Weekly payout is transferred every Friday, or the next banking working day if Friday is a holiday.
notes: OCR-verified, page 53 rule 6 of 10, and restated on page 33.

rule_text: All income illustrations, examples, and figures in the compensation plan are for informational purposes only. Actual income varies and depends entirely on individual performance and the number of direct sponsored distributors — no income is guaranteed.
notes: OCR-verified, page 53, rule 10 of 10 — this is the plan's own official disclaimer language and is the primary compliance anchor for 'do_not_say' income-claim prohibitions across this entire knowledge base. rule_text: Minimum payout threshold is Rs 500; payout amounts below this are clubbed with the next payout cycle. Exception: if a distributor resigns, any outstanding amount is paid regardless of the Rs 500 threshold.
notes: Not present in the 58-page OCR of the GrowthX Plan Presentation reviewed for this build. Sourced only from the narrative document's website citation. See compensation_gap_report.csv G-006.

rule_text: BV (Business Volume): the point-value unit used throughout the compensation plan to measure purchase volume for matching, rank, and reward calculations.
notes: BV is used consistently and unambiguously throughout the OCR'd plan; no single explicit dictionary-style definition sentence exists in the OCR text, but usage is uniform across all 58 pages reviewed.

rule_text: DP (Distributor Price): the price at which Dayjoy Independent Distributors may purchase a product, lower than MRP.
notes: OCR-verified explicit definition on page 30 ('DP: Distributor Price').

rule_text: MRP (Maximum Retail Price): the price at which a distributor may resell a product to a retail customer.
notes: OCR-verified, page 30.

rule_text: Active Distributor: an Independent Distributor whose Self ID has been activated with a minimum of 2,500 BV.
